pages.title: Ontological Processor
pages.text: The sixth tier of processor. It does not compute answers; it decides what is true, writing its results directly into the source code of reality. Holographic matrices store its working and Bekenstein crystals bound its memory. Near it, simple facts feel slightly negotiable.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)On the Femtoscale Assembly Line I combined a Cosmic Processor with a Source Code Fragment, a Holographic Matrix and a Bekenstein Crystal. Its first output was not a number but a correction to the world.
